Container.Name: nanokvm-dashboard
Container.Overview: Local-first NanoKVM dashboard with mDNS discovery, device grouping, favorites, and status checks. Enable mDNS on your NanoKVM devices. Host networking is required for local multicast discovery.

Config.Name: HTTP port
Config.Description: Host mode binds directly to this port. Update WebUI if changed.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Run as Unraid nobody by default.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Run as Unraid users group by default.

Config.Name: mDNS interfaces
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated Unraid LAN IPv4 addresses, for example 192.168.1.10. Leave empty for all interfaces.

Config.Name: Dashboard username
Config.Description: Optional Basic Auth; set both username and password.

Config.Name: Dashboard password
Config.Description: Optional Basic Auth; this is not your NanoKVM password.
